windowsEvaluation.grantCondition: Separate counsel-reviewed evaluation agreement, signed exact artifact and scoped user/device/edition/module entitlement
windowsEvaluation.runtimeCheck: Verify signed licence, expiry, nonce and device binding on protected functions; online-only protected functions use short renewable server lease
windowsEvaluation.expiry: Protected use denied after expiry unless a newly signed paid subscription entitlement is verified

googleCloudPilot.identity: Verified named invitee, MFA and service-enforced per-tenant identity. Never trust role or tenant from browser
googleCloudPilot.serverEnforcement: Deny expired, revoked, missing, exhausted, unpaid and counterfeit evaluation claims on every protected operation. Verify server persisted subscription status, scope, usage and budget atomically.
googleCloudPilot.resourceQuotas: Atomic per-tenant run counters, storage and cost limits, with circuit breaker and no billable processing after expiry/limit.
googleCloudPilot.offboard: Invalidate refresh/session tokens, revoke signed URL issuance, stop queue scheduling, terminate workers where feasible, purge temporary data at policy deadline and issue receipts.
googleCloudPilot.paidConversion: Show read-only end-of-trial state and verified governed-commercial links; no automatic charge, no grandfathered free execution, no reactivation without signed paid entitlement.
googleCloudPilot.customerData: Only allowed after separate runtime, privacy, IAM and data lifecycle certification; forbidden today

commercialLinks.language: After a genuine trial ends, protected features stop. Request a paid licence or governed deployment. Plans and fees require approved written terms.
commercialLinks.doNotClaim: Payment or subscriptions are automatic, prices final, or production runtime immediately available.

transitionGuards.NOT_ISSUED->FREE_EVALUATION_ACTIVE: trial service certified + identity MFA + signed terms + signed bounded entitlement + owner cost approved
transitionGuards.FREE_EVALUATION_ACTIVE->EVALUATION_EXPIR: time or usage or cost exhausted, atomically recorded and protected access denied
transitionGuards.FREE_EVALUATION_ACTIVE->REVOKED: signed revocation receipt or admin action, protected access denied
transitionGuards.EVALUATION_EXPIRED->PAID_PENDING_VERIFIC: customer requests commercial terms, no entitlement
transitionGuards.PAID_PENDING_VERIFICATION->PAID_ACTIVE: paid contract + payment/approved billing evidence + signed paid entitlement + scope verified
transitionGuards.PAID_ACTIVE->PAID_SUSPENDED: payment or term suspension from authoritative billing/license service, protected access denied
